Only genuinely versioned rows may show COF match, fully unknown legacy packets remain COF 0. Native real LLUDP Low158 multi-row wire and COF-evidence tests, Python integration and full Mint x64 GUI gate. Previous Alpha824 Pi5 exact SHA 730f115 Run 39836372832 success.
